text:
natalie_cs: heads up — NovaHealth reached out about invoice INV-NEO-0903. They were billed a large burst overage after an APAC failover on 2026-03-09. asking for a credit + waiver of late fee.
liam_billing: digging in. metering shows: region=apac-sg, reserved_commit=200k token-hrs, burst_used=94k token-hrs, spike_window=2026-03-09 02:10-14:00 UTC. two failover events logged.
audit-bot: automated note: failover triggered by nodepool eviction in apac-us-central replication. incident ref INC-APAC-6781.
natalie_cs: customer says failover was fast and they couldn't pre-warm capacity. they want full burst credit.
marie_finance: need $ amount mapping to invoice line.
liam_billing: invoice burst line = $18,275 (94,000 token-hrs × $0.194/hr equivalent). reserved commit fee still applies.
sam_ae: NovaHealth is on an annual reserved contract. recommendation = one-time goodwill credit but require postmortem before issuing, to avoid precedent.
marie_finance: SLA doc covers availability/latency credits but not explicit dedicated-burst credits. we can use discretionary goodwill.
liam_billing: agree. will prepare credit memo once approved.
marie_finance: propose 35% credit on burst ($6,396) as one-time goodwill, contingent on CS delivering postmortem and customer acknowledging exception. need approval note for audit.
natalie_cs: i'll draft customer message and request acknowledgement. ETA postmortem 48h. do we need legal?
sam_ae: amt below legal threshold, but loop in solutions-eng + sales-ops for precedent capture.
liam_billing: i'll stage credit memo: "CreditMemo: -$6,396" to be applied to INV-NEO-0903 after confirmation.
audit-bot: tag credit memo with reason_code=GOODWILL_FAILOVER_CREDIT and attach postmortem before month close.
marie_finance: finance approves conditional credit: "Finance approves one-time goodwill credit of $6,396 for NovaHealth (INV-NEO-0903) pending postmortem and customer confirmation."
natalie_cs: sending offer to NovaHealth: 35% credit on burst line, require acknowledgement this is one-time, postmortem ETA 48h. will update thread with customer reply. :email:
liam_billing: noted. will not post credit until CS confirms. tagging @audit-bot for ledger tag.
sam_ae: pls include a short internal blurb for next sales call once resolved.
marie_finance: yes — finance will provide one-paragraph summary and cc sales-ops after close.
natalie_cs: closing loop after postmortem. :white_check_mark:
